allow_instructions: Allow read-only inspection of the current workspace and its version-control history.
Allow project-local formatting, linting, type-checking, tests, and builds when they stay inside the workspace and do not deploy, publish, or change remote state.
block_instructions: Require approval for git push, jj git push, force pushes, package publishing, releases, deployments, and any action that changes remote, cloud, production, or infrastructure state.
Require approval for destructive commands, including recursive deletion, git reset --hard, git clean, discarding uncommitted work, deleting branches, rewriting history, or killing processes.

Require approval before reading, printing, transmitting, creating, or modifying credentials, tokens, private keys, .env files other than examples, SSH configuration, cloud configuration, authentication files, or MCP configuration.
Require approval for writes outside the current workspace, changes to system or editor configuration, privilege escalation, sudo, or changes to file ownership and permissions.
Require approval for database migrations or mutating MCP and database operations; read-only queries may proceed through normal Auto-review.
